thread:
maria: Heads up — noticing a p95 and p99 latency jump on canary after the kernel-autoswitch + batching heuristic tweak. Canary is 5% traffic to group A. Prefetch/hitrate graphs show a sharp drop in prefix hits for a subset of tenants. :eyes:

infra-bot: deploy canary 2026-06-15T18:42Z - feature: kernel-autoswitch=true batching_v2=true

owen: pulling perf traces now, give me 5

jess: can you paste the eviction/hitrate timeseries? also which kernel was chosen? wondering if fallback selection changed

maria: attaching quick snip from metrics (trimmed):
```
tenant_id=acme p95=220ms -> 450ms
prefix_hitrate=0.78 -> 0.12
eviction_rate=0.004 -> 0.18
kernel_variant=auto -> switched to kernel-v2-quant
```
seeing many KV cache misses where we used to hit

kai: FYI we flipped a normalization flag in serialization packer earlier (strip_trailing_nuls=true) — could that change prefix keys?

rory: I ran a quick flamegraph on the canary pod — top sample is memcpy + memmove in kernel-v2, also lots of time in 'kv_lookup_miss_path'. Sounds like data layout mismatch + more cache churn.

maria: interesting. who toggled strip_trailing_nuls? @kai did that ship with the autoswitch PR or earlier?

kai: that flag landed in serialization PR last week, independent of autoswitch. But autoswitch may have selected a kernel variant that expects packed keys without trailing nuls, causing different prefix hashing. :grimacing:

perf-bot: alert -> prefix_hitrate_drop for group A; correlated with deploy id=20260615-2042

sam: safe rollback plan: route canary traffic back to kernel-v1 for group A, then run a diff of key hashes for a sample of requests. Command:
```
redwood route pin --group A --kernel kernel-v1 --reason "hitrate collapse" --duration 30m
```

ash: also can we test a hotfix that disables normalization at packer level and run A/B? might be faster than full rollback

jess: don't split variables — start with rollback to stop impact, then validate the hypothesis. I'll run a sample job to compare raw keys -> packed keys -> hash for 10k requests.

owen: rolling back canary routing now

infra-bot: routing update: group A pinned to kernel-v1 (rollout_id=roll-20260615-2110)

maria: p95 trending down already. Thanks all. I'll file a follow-up ticket to add unit tests for key normalization invariants and a canary check to compare prefix hashes when kernel variant changes. :white_check_mark:

rory: opening postmortem doc, assigning owners: root-cause=serialization-normalization + autoswitch kernel mismatch

maria: noted — will include perf diffs and the sample hash outputs

kai: sorry — will revert the normalization flag and open a PR with opt-in behavior behind explicit compat tag

sam: leaving this thread with the rollback patch id and test logs

maria: great work everyone, thumbs up. :thumbsup:
